mathematical_claim: For an affine angular circle image, equal centers/radii, signed span, and radial plus signed tangent frames at a shared parameter prove equality over the complete trim interval. The prior direct-domain frame remains an alternate exact proof if the anchored frame is unresolved.

reproduced_failures.original_scope: The second baseline attempt executes all six wrong-phase/tilted-plane controls across cylinder, sphere and cone. All return Ok incorrectly; independent exact point assertions establish the mismatch.
reproduced_failures.rejection: Full native configurations lose two unchanged STEP circle successes to PredicateUnresolved; the corresponding WASM run traps. Preserve these failures and source; they are not admitted results.

count_scope: Feature configurations overlap. Counts include inherited unit/integration/doc tests. The public circle matrix has seven iso families times 16 direction/frame/trim combinations (112), each checked twice and independently evaluated at five parameters. Neither those samples nor counts alone establish the full-interval proof.

wasm.scope: Five new whole-image query groups plus eight preserved STEP groups. Exact analytic import and replay; directed source parameters and seam uses; partial arcs, reversed normals, oblique/radical frames and senses; length/angle units; split/reflection/Boolean/empty continuation; typed invalid and unsupported sources; ownership, source accounting and resource limits.

benchmark.scope: Three alternating CPU-0 pairs over complete preserved BREP/STEP/arc corpora; identical required receipts and fixture facts. Output comparisons supplement independent semantic tests. Shared-host descriptive observations, not a general speedup or total-resource bound.

new_query_costs.scope: Absolute shared-host observations, not a speedup or total-memory bound. Fresh means new staged geometry each iteration; process/scalar caches are not globally reset. Reused input is warmed before measurement. Invalid correspondence has a separate outcome and is never counted as faster successful geometry.

historical_limits: Earlier archive-admission and short cached-arc timing exceptions retain their original scope.
External timeouts and allocator requested-byte counters do not establish complete retained-memory, cancellation or total-work admission.
